proposals.action_title: Launch 1st KDP Coloring Book (Niche: Bold & Easy Cozy Minimalist)
proposals.why_this_works_now: The 'Bold & Easy' / 'Cozy' minimalist coloring book trend is exploding on TikTok and Amazon. Since it requires thick lines and simple shapes, it is perfectly suited for FLUX-schnell (via Together AI/Cloudflare) without needing complex prompt tuning or high-end upscaling.
proposals.first_action_today: Run the existing produce_coloring_book pipeline configured with TOGETHER_API_KEY using the 'Bold and Easy Hygge Life' theme to generate 40 clean coloring pages.

proposals.action_title: Cross-list KDP pages as a Printable Digital PDF Pack on Etsy
proposals.why_this_works_now: Many customers prefer printing coloring pages at home on high-quality cardstock rather than using cheap Amazon paper. Listing the exact same assets generated for KDP as a digital PDF download on Etsy doubles the monetization of the asset with zero extra generation cost.
proposals.first_action_today: Create a free Ko-fi or Etsy shop, bundle the 40 high-res PNGs from your first coloring book into a single PDF, and write a listing titled '40 Printable Bold & Easy Cozy Coloring Pages PDF'.

proposals.action_title: Bulk-upload 50 Minimalist Typography Stickers on Redbubble
proposals.why_this_works_now: Redbubble is already registered. Typography stickers require exactly 0 GPU rendering power. A simple Python script running in Termux using PIL (Pillow) can render white-bordered PNG text stickers based on trending funny/relatable quotes for specific niches (e.g., developers, introverts).
proposals.first_action_today: Write a Python script on Termux to auto-generate 50 high-resolution transparent PNG typography stickers with clean white borders and upload them to Redbubble using their multi-product template.

proposals.action_title: Publish 5 Parametric 3D Models (Gridfinity / Organizers) using OpenSCAD
proposals.why_this_works_now: Cults3D is planned. OpenSCAD allows generating 3D printable STL files purely through code (highly compatible with Termux and GitHub Actions). Functional 3D prints (like customized storage, cable organizers, or Gridfinity modules) sell consistently for 1.50€ - 3.00€ to makers who want to save time modeling.
proposals.first_action_today: Adapt an open-source parametric OpenSCAD script for a custom battery/SD card organizer, render 5 popular size configurations via GitHub Actions, and list them as paid STL files on Cults3D.

proposals.why_this_works_now: To bypass the AI image bottleneck entirely, launch low-content logbooks (e.g., Beekeeping Log Book, Daily Food & Symptom Tracker). The interiors are simple tables/grids generated programmatically, and covers are clean, high-contrast typography, making them fast to compile and publish.
proposals.first_action_today: Trigger the produce_lowcontent_kdp pipeline for three highly targeted, non-fictional hobbies like 'Mushroom Foraging Log Book' or 'Sourdough Baking Journal'.
